userSettings.name: corsProxy
userSettings.label: CORS proxy (optional)
userSettings.description: Used only when a direct request from Python/JavaScript is blocked by the browser (CORS). Prefix, e.g. https://corsproxy.io/?url= or use {url} as placeholder. Requests that fall back to it are visible to that proxy.

openaiSpec.name: run_code
openaiSpec.description: Execute code and return its printed output. Languages: python, javascript, sql (SQLite), c, c++, rust, go, ruby, java, csharp, haskell, lua. Use whenever a result should be computed rather than guessed. Always print/puts/println the values you want returned. INTERNET: python has requests, urllib.request and pyodide.http.pyfetch; javascript has fetch. Browser CORS applies unless the user set a CORS proxy in the plugin settings. STORAGE: /workspace is a temporary in-memory directory shared by python (its cwd), javascript (await fs.readFile/writeFile/appendFile/readdir/exists/unlink/mkdir/stat; storage.get/set for values) and sql. Files and the SQL database persist across calls until page reload. Python can open the SQL database as /workspace/data.sqlite with sqlite3. Compiler Explorer languages (c, c++, rust, go, ruby, java, csharp, haskell, lua) have no internet and no persistent files. For Java, do NOT declare the class public.

language.description: Language to execute the code in.

code.description: Complete source code. Must print its own output.

packages.description: Python only. PyPI packages to install via micropip first, e.g. ['pandas']. Slow - omit unless genuinely needed. numpy/pandas/scipy also auto-load from imports without this.
